provenance.manuscriptTitle: sclineage integrates hierarchical lineage inference with conditional cell-state generation
provenance.version: NM_scLineage (27).pdf; Overleaf-compiled manuscript downloaded 2026-11-25; website data and figure assets reviewed 2026-11-26.
provenance.values: Numeric labels and prose from the current manuscript, plus exact source CSV records verified against the current figure content. Matched OT-CFM source-figure content is byte-identical to current S14. Obsolete full-path ablation precision/recall values were excluded. No unlabeled plotted coordinates were digitized.
provenance.animations: Conceptual animations are illustrative and must be labelled. Reported metrics and figure panels are measured results.

depth.capacityMeaning: Maximum nodes in the binary codebook at the selected depth.
depth.source: Figure 2b; Supplementary Figure S7a,b; Results page 2
depth.note: Displayed map NMI values describe one held-out fit (seed 44). Peak mean and median summarize five fits. Do not connect these distinct summaries into a numeric depth curve. All-six-level numerical values require the source-data table.

routeAblation.fixed: Hierarchy-aware OT coupling, cost and path-cost weight; matched network parameter counts.
routeAblation.source: Figure 5c; Supplementary Figure S12; Results page 3; Section S3.5 page 29
routeAblation.note: Mean ± sample standard deviation. Full-path precision/recall summarize three repetitions, each averaging five resamples of 500 generated and 500 observed cells. All other ablation estimates summarize three model seeds (42–44), with 4,000 generated cells per fit. Five resamples are within a repetition, not five independent model fits.

sourceValidation.numericSource: source_data_legacy.csv in NM_scLineage (1).zip, retained only for the unchanged ablation records; current Results page 3 supplies the revised full-path precision/recall.
sourceValidation.validation: The current S12a SWD/MMD plotting content is unchanged from the archive. No-route and leaf-only means/SDs agree with current S12b; its horizontal axis was expanded for the new full-path point. Archived full-path precision 0.5276 and recall 0.6299 are obsolete and were excluded.

populationBenchmarks.note: Pearson R, SWD and RBF-MMD summarize three model seeds. Recall summarizes three repetitions, each averaging five 500-cell resamples. SD is sample standard deviation.

generation.source: Figure 5d; Supplementary Figure S13a; Section S3.6
generation.note: D6 expression excluded from generator fitting. A common fate readout was fitted on 172 development clones. Technical variability across three model seeds.

representation.note: RNA from D2, D4 and D6 was used for representation fitting. Barcode-linked outcomes in held-out clone groups were used for evaluation.

branchSwitching.fixed: Source cells, initial noise and target day are identical across paired neutrophil and monocyte requests.
branchSwitching.unit: Fate composition in percent. Switching in percentage points.
branchSwitching.note: Fates are assigned by an independent expression classifier. These are model predictions under requested paths. Confidence intervals use 2,000 paired clone-bootstrap resamples.

pancreas.note: Each method was fitted separately on the pancreatic training cohort. This evaluates applicability in an independent system.

barcode-evaluation.caption: Fig. 4a. Barcode-linked fate-evaluation scheme. RNA from D2, D4 and D6 is used to fit representations; barcode-linked descendants provide the fate-evaluation target. Barcodes are excluded from representation learning.

barcode-clone-examples.caption: Fig. 4b,c. Original D2-to-D6 clone maps and fate-composition bars for clone 4123 (17 observed neutrophil descendants) and clone 802 (27 observed monocyte descendants). These are illustrative clones; sclineage assigns 95.6% and 78.0% probability to the respective observed fate.

barcode-fate-evaluation.caption: Fig. 4d,e. Original cohort-level native-readout error plots and shared-readout precision–recall curves. Native TV uses 978 D4-to-D6 test clones, and conditional N/(N+M) MAE uses 672 eligible clones. The shared ten-fate readout uses 375 D2-to-D6 and 978 D4-to-D6 test clones. Confidence intervals quantify clone-sampling uncertainty with fitted predictions held fixed.
barcode-fate-evaluation.displayType: Fig. 4d: native-readout error bars; Fig. 4e: precision–recall curves with paired AP-difference confidence intervals. AUROC/AP point estimates are in Supplementary Fig. S10b.

generation-benchmarks.caption: Fig. 5f. Original held-out population benchmarks for TIGON, scDiffEq and sclineage across D4 interpolation, D6 forward extrapolation and D2 backward extrapolation. Pearson R, SWD and RBF-MMD summarize seeds 42–44; kNN recall summarizes three repetitions of resampling. Bars and whiskers show means and sample standard deviations.

ct34-ancestry.caption: Supplementary Fig. S1b. Reference and sclineage terminal-route skeletons for seed 44, constructed from the same 29,612 observed cells with one deterministic representative per terminal state. Of 190 terminal pairs, 185 have identical ancestor groups and five have compatible finer splits; all 13 non-trivial reference ancestor groups are retained. This is a fixed-fit comparison, not a five-fit mean. The panel is S1b, not Fig. 3d.

generation-clone-fidelity.caption: Fig. 5d. Original source-clone fate-fidelity comparison for generated D6 states, evaluated against barcode-linked descendants of 530 D2 source cells from 375 test clones. A common probability readout fitted on 172 development clones estimates neutrophil, monocyte and other-fate proportions. Filled symbols and whiskers summarize three technical seeds (42–44); the open diamond shows the shuffled control. Lower mean clone-level total variation indicates greater agreement.

structureValidation.scope: Separate selected-region route examples, one displayed graph fit, and five-fit aggregate scores; these are distinct evaluations.

sources: Supplementary Figs. S1a and S9d (pages 32 and 40)
selectedRegionRoutes.scope: Two retrospectively selected local regions; counts are not whole-dataset recovery rates. Non-reference transitions count distinct cell-to-cell edges crossing directed state transitions absent from the reference.

displayedTopology.scope: One displayed fit, seed 44, using 60 fixed native root-to-terminal queries and common coordinates for all 34 states. Extra connections include additional or reversed edges. These counts and F1 scores are not five-fit means.

branchLocalization.scope: Selected explicitly reported numerical comparison; not a complete numerical transcription of every method in Fig. 3b.

terminalAncestry.scope: Fixed seed-44 terminal-state skeleton, one deterministic representative for each of 20 terminal states. Pair counts are not averaged over technical fits.

fateReadouts.scope: Representation and hierarchy fitting used RNA from all three days (D2, D4 and D6). Barcodes, sampling days and cell-state labels were excluded from representation learning. Sampling days and mature D6 annotations subsequently informed fate readouts. This is transductive representation evaluation with held-out clone groups, distinct from held-out-day generation.
fateReadouts.cloneEligibility: At least one cell at the early time point and at least three mature D6 descendants; early-cell predictions are averaged within each clone.

nativeTV.scope: Each method uses its native fate readout. Mean error compares predicted and barcode-linked observed three-fate proportions, with clones weighted equally.

uncertainty.scope: Clone-sampling uncertainty with fitted predictions held fixed; numerical native-TV intervals are not transcribed here.

commonAP.positiveDefinition: For each fate, a clone is positive if at least one sampled mature D6 descendant has that annotation.

uncertainty.retentionRule: Both positive and negative clones must be present for all ten fates.
uncertainty.scope: Intervals quantify clone-sampling uncertainty for the paired AP difference, with fitted predictions held fixed; they are not confidence intervals for each individual AP score.

commonAUROC.source: Supplementary Fig. S10b (page 41), not main Fig. 4e.
commonAUROC.readout: Shared day-ordered readout on ten mature fates
commonAUROC.scope: Same transductive representation and held-out-clone evaluation as commonAP. Main Fig. 4e shows PR curves; Supplementary Fig. S10b displays both AP and AUROC point estimates.

biologicalCompositionExample.scope: The common readout assigns 21.07% of observed D6 cells to neutrophils; their annotation-based percentage is separately 21.64%. Generated percentages are means across three repetitions of 4,000 cells each.

matchedOTCFM.note: Matched-population comparison, distinct from the main TIGON/scDiffEq population benchmark. Means and sample standard deviations across three model seeds. Precision and recall are stored as fractions; the paper displays percentages and SDs in percentage points.
matchedOTCFM.source: Supplementary Fig. S14 (page 45); source_data_otcfm_matched_population.csv; Methods page 20 and Supplementary Section S3.14 pages 30–31.

sourceValidation.validation: The companion supplementary_otcfm_matched_population.pdf page-content stream is byte-for-byte identical to the embedded S14 figure in the current NM_scLineage (27).pdf. Exact CSV values are used; no plotted coordinates were digitized.
